comments.author: Alrn
comments.body:
The purple version of this shoes can be obtained from 'Treasure map' in Sakai's archives, with r11 appraisal to pull the map. Needs r11 search and unlock to use, located in southeast near the landmark in North Lima.

Stats : 40/40 Durability, Defence Power 8, Appraisal +1, Required Total Fame 5000
